new_statements.second_reader_evidence: Only one work was listed, so no other listed works could be spot-checked; instead I searched the four companion files already held by the project in the same directory for stress/accent/prominence/tone/pitch/syllable: English companion article, 0 hits for all terms), 2004 FLI trip report; 0 hits; the surveyors found no fluent speaker and obtained no word list), 0 hits), 7 'accent' hits, all in the citation of van der Hulst, Goedemans & van Zanten 2010 'A Survey of Word Accentual Patterns..' p. 551, where Badeshi appears only as a name under UNCLASSIFIED Indo-Iranian; no accent data). Nothing about stress in any of them; no missed statement.
